title: brassica oleracea convar. gemmifera
intro: Brassica oleracea convar. gemmifera, commonly known as Brussels sprouts, is a cultivar of the cabbage family that is characterized by its compact, small, and rounded buds that resemble miniature cabbages. The health benefits of Brussels sprouts include being rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of Brussels sprouts include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, as well as its ability to support digestive health and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Brussels sprouts include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
